notes: Printed Peer into the Abyss: 'Target player draws cards equal to half the number of cards in their library and loses half their life. Round up each time.' The opponent's library holds 7 cards (6 filler + 1): they draw ceil(7/2) = 4. Their life is 15: they lose ceil(15/2) = 8, down to 7. The caster draws and loses nothing.
